items.en: Ukraine's ANT upgrades Mercury VTOL reconnaissance UAS: up to 300 km range, 4-5 h endurance and FHSS backup link against Russian EW
items.nl: Oekraïense ANT moderniseert Mercury VTOL-verkenningsdrone: tot 300 km bereik, 4-5 uur vliegduur en FHSS-reserveverbinding tegen Russische EW
items.sEn: Ukrainian company ANT (Aviation New Technologies) has unveiled an upgraded version of its Mercury reconnaissance UAS, Militarnyi reports. According to the developer, maximum altitude rises from 3,000 to 4,000 m, rated endurance from 2.5 to 4 hours (up to five in practice), and maximum range from 170 to 250 km, reachin…
